ValidationRule.description: SDRs can only create Leads, never Contacts. Blocks Contact creation by users in an SDR role (role API name starting with SDR_). Lead conversion is not blocked as long as the org setting "Require Validation for Converted Leads" is off. Skipped when the On/Off Switch Run Validation Rules is unchecked.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: SDRs can't create Contacts. Create a Lead instead. It becomes a Contact when it's converted.
